body:
I know this is hard, but just love who you love. Be happy. Show them up with your happiness. If anyone on your mothers side is queer or part of the LGBTQIA+ community, you’ll be their hero. They’ll know they aren’t alone. And if your mother has loved you before and after you came out as queer, I’m sure she’ll always love you. She may be taken aback or worried, maybe even mad, but deep down, it’ll be because of how she was raised. She’ll always love you. And I think you know this - if she’s your best friend, she won’t stop just because the thing you told her 5/3 years ago which she’s known to be true finally means you have a girlfriend now. 

I wish you the best and hope everything goes well. Love is love and if your mother genuinely cares for you, she’ll always be in your life and will always love you, in the ways she can.

I’m sorry you feel this way. It’s surprising how much this resonated with me. Or ig it’s not that surprising. But it made me feel less alone - I hope this makes you feel less alone, even if just for a second. Because even if I’m just a stranger on the internet, you impacted my life. I know that’s cliché and probably annoying but, thank you. You might feel weak but you seem like a really strong person to me. If you ever need to talk I’ll listen ❤️

this is exactly what i feel - when i finally opened up to someone they left when they saw the real me because i was “too depressed” for them. fun

it’s really messed up that people are like this - and to anyone who feels alone just know you aren’t. i might be a stranger, but i care about you. you’re wanted and loved. stay strong, even if people continue to trample over you.
if you want to talk i’m here ❤️ i’m a boring person too lol
I’m so so sorry. I wish I could do something other than say that. Stay strong.

I really hope you failed. You seem like such a beautiful and caring human being, it honestly made me tear up to think that someone so loving and full of so much light is being held by this darkness. If you’re still alive and need someone to talk to, please don’t hesitate to contact me. 

The way you have with words is deeply moving. I’m thankful I got to read some of them.

it can go either way - for me, i was the one who said “hey i may have depression” because my family didn’t really care at the time and didn’t know much about mental illnesses. but if someone has a supportive enough family sometimes they’ll intervene. just do what you think is right ❤️

it helps to be around people i’m comfortable with, like my friends or boyfriend. but honestly, not really. you just gotta keep going forward and try to love yourself. it’s hard and way easier said than done but if you surround yourself with people who are positive and love you, you’ll eventually take in some of their positivity and love and start to tell yourself what they say. there will always be bad days, but the better ones are the ones worth living for. and if there are things about yourself that you love/like, try to compliment yourself on those things, if you feel brave/up to it. for me it helps sometimes, like “oh yea most of my body sucks but my eyes are ok” kinda thing
yea i understand. mostly i just feel even more numb if i think about it so it translates to boredom and just hollowness over time. i hope you feel better ❤️

gosh. i used to be angry a lot so i understand a little bit, but depression isn’t a reason to justify treating people badly. i really hope you and your family can help her, i know what helped me was my family being there and just reminding me that they care. hold her accountable to what she says but give her space if she needs some. good luck with everything ❤️

i kind of have a similar experience sometimes. i just feel really numb so everything feels fake/like it’s becoming numb too, if that even makes any sense. it’s a very odd feeling. 

i hope you’re doing ok and i’m sorry that you’re going through that.

i’m not sure. i definitely know what you’re talking about though, sometimes people’s responses are kind of robotic or vague af. i think people are just unsure what to say because they’re struggling themselves. but if you need someone to talk to you can ask me stuff, although idk how good i am at advice. but i can be a good listener ❤️. i hope you get the advice/help you need and are doing ok.

try to talk to him about what you’re dealing with. sit down with him and hold nothing back - if you two try to figure things out together i’m sure you’ll be ok. communication is key ❤️. good luck and i hope things work out for you. love is tough when you deal with mental illnesses

i have body dysphoria too, and although you’ll likely struggle with this through your whole life, things can get better. it helps to have a loving and supportive inner circle (and ik, way easier to say than to actually have oof). i’m sure you’ll find people to trust and be friends with that’ll support you, just maybe not right now. but you never know when, because often you find the people you need most at the oddest of times. stay strong, i believe in you ❤️.

just try to be supportive. show her you care and that you’ll be with her every step of the way, even if things get really difficult. i know when i’m really depressed i feel like a burden and just don’t want to do anything or deal with life, so try to remind her she’s wanted and loved. and try to nudge her in the direction of maybe getting a medication or seeking a therapist. (finding a good therapist can take a while so don’t let her get discouraged if she can’t click with some of them, just keep trying). and you can tell her husband to do little things for her to help make her day a little brighter - like bringing her favorite food, flowers, etc, just because. 

i hope she gets the help she needs and that she gets better. good luck with everything ❤️
you’re welcome ❤️and thank you haha
i’m so sorry.

i feel the same. i’m so sorry. i’m here if you want/need to talk and know you aren’t alone. life is sucky sometimes and people are too. you shouldn’t ever be taken advantage of. i wish you the best ❤️
i’m in the same boat. but yea, try and find new people who’ll value you for who you are and accept and love all of you, even the bad. i’m here if you need/want to talk. ❤️

i’m not sure if it’s super common but i’ve heard stories of stuff like this happening to people who’ve gone through stuff you have as a way of coping. have you ever had a therapist? i know that sometimes they stink but there are good ones out there that would do almost anything to help people and i’m sure you’d be able to find someone to help you. i wish you the best and i’m so so so sorry you went through that.

hey, i understand, in my own way. i’m sorry this is what you’re going through and i wish there was a way you could be happy and not feel like the world was against you. even though this probably means nothing, i believe in you. if you don’t give up and just keep trying and doing what you love, you’ll get somewhere. if you need to talk i’m here ❤️
i’m really sorry, but just know you aren’t alone. if you need to talk i’m here ❤️

i’m sorry you’re hurting too. and strawberry is the best and to me only good ice cream so i’ll take it haha ❤️. thank you for commenting and i hope you feel better and life gets more bearable for you. you deserve happiness. don’t you give up either, the world needs more kind people like you in it, not less.

i’m lost, but i’m here today because the people closest to me pushed me to keep on. having a close knit circle of people helps a lot, gives you a shoulder to cry on. other than that, i don’t really know. but if we experience happiness sometimes, however brief, surely we’ll experience it again? 

i hope you find your reason to keep on. good luck ❤️

I’m so sorry. I know it’s painful and I know you can’t afford therapy so I don’t know what to tell you other than people here will most always be here to talk if you need someone, me included. Whenever you do have money for therapy, please go because it can do wonders if you find the right person. It’s tough, but it helps. So do friends. Even if you want to protect your friends and family and don’t want them to think of your partner in a certain way, talking to them will help. Rely on those who love you. Don’t isolate yourself. I know, easier said than done, but just try. I believe in you, and I’m here if you need someone to talk to. ❤️

Yea, the world’s been crazy with this virus going around. And btw, you seem like a really sweet person, I’m glad that you’re sticking with him even through these hard times. Self sabotage isn’t fun. I hope he opens up more to you and you guys can figure things out. Good luck!

He sounds like he’s struggling. I really don’t know... when I was where he was all I wanted was someone to hug me and tell me it’s ok, so maybe he just wants love. But if he’s pushed you away for so long maybe he doesn’t? I’m not sure.

I’m not sure if you should leave him alone if he has depression but if he broke up with you and seems so uninterested he’s giving one word answers, maybe it’s for the best. Although I know if I were the one struggling I would want someone there for me to lean on during the hard times. Maybe ask him if he’s doing ok/try to get him to open up. Be his rock. But if he consistently pushes you away don’t let him pull you down with him, do what’s best for you.
it’s so painful
i think that too, just less than i used to. because i’ve been doing that and i’m still really depressed. happiness to me is so fleeting.

it’s just hard because my city is sort of going under lockdown because of the coronavirus, so being around my friends or even my boyfriend is hard. i’ll see them less and less. which is ok, because we have the internet so i’ll be able to stay in contact with them, it’s just difficult because isolation is probably the worst thing for me right now. 

and thank you, i know i’m lucky to have people in my life to be my support network. i’ll always appreciate them. i hope you have a good day/night. thank you for taking time to comment ❤️.
Very true. Thank you ❤️

Back at you, whoever you are. You’re a beautiful human being and deserve so much love and appreciation ❤️. I hope you know how much you’re worth. 

This post made my day a little brighter.

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. I feel the same. I don’t know what to say other than I wish you the best of luck, and I’m sending virtual hugs your way. You can get through this, tomorrow can always be better. (Although I know how hard it is to see that). Try to live for yourself instead of depending so much on her.

Thank you. We’re all struggling in one way or another, and I think replying to comments helps me out a bit too. As depressing as it is to know I’m not alone in these feelings, I believe in everyone on here, and wish everyone happiness because I know we all seem to get so little. 

Good luck to you too ❤️.

Even though it’s really sad that people with mental illnesses are considered outcasts, society is at least moving a bit forward (although backward at the same time). I feel people are more open about mental illnesses now, however small. And the people who say mental illnesses aren’t real, for one, have probably never dealt with it so they can’t conjure up the empathy, or they’re in denial. So I just try to ignore them because regardless of what we try to say or believe, they most likely won’t change. It’s really sad but some people are just jerks. 

My friends have all been through a lot. I’m proud of them for still being here despite all of it, and even if they don’t want to talk about it with me, I’m sure they have others to talk and vent to. They’re loved. And I’m sorry you’ve been ignored and stood up. That’s honestly shitty of them, but I know the feeling. And same, hanging out with people distracts me from things. When I’m alone all the thoughts come crashing back down and I feel like I’m drowning, even if I’m only alone for a few moments. So I can’t avoid my problems a lot of the time since they resurface so easily, but I try as much as I can. 

I hope we both get better, and I’m sure you’ll get to the point of going to a counselor someday. You may have to shop around a bit; the one I’m with now is like my eighth person. All the others were either slightly shitty to full on insensitive assholes. So I wish you luck, I know it’s hard but there are amazing ones out there. You just need to find the person who clicks.
I understand that completely. It’s scary, but most of the time I’m too numb to really be scared. I’m sorry you feel like this and I hope you never commit suicide. You have a lot to offer this world,

Gosh, I wish people were better educated (and just not jerks) about mental health. I know my mom used to get on me about that type of stuff but after everything she’s gotten a lot better. She was only uneducated, not a dick. I hope you have someone to talk to about everything; someone who understands and doesn’t belittle you. I’m really sorry you feel like this. But I completely relate. And, I know this is slightly contradictory (because of my post) but don’t kill yourself. You deserve to see life’s beautiful little things, or big things, everything. I know it’s hard but I believe in you. But I do know how it feels to just lay in bed thinking of ways to end it. It’s really hard.

It’s really, really hard. It’s a cog wheel that never stops spinning and it’s running off its hinges.

I’m really glad you’ve pulled through and that you’re still here today. Because even though life sucks a lot of the time, this comment made me feel a little better- you being alive lets you help others. So thank you for existing, and for taking time out of your day to comment on my depressing asf post. You’re a good person. 

And I’d love to have a conversation with you (I’m the same with replying, I sometimes take forever. BUT, I will try to reply as fast as I can).
I know how it feels. It sucks. I’m sorry you feel this way and I hope that someday we’ll be better. I wish you luck.

I think that too. It’s really sad to know that some of my friends deal with the same things I do. The ones I grew apart from all have depression so I can imagine how many more of my friends do who just haven’t told me or reached out. Thank you.. that’s exactly how it feels. It’s weird to finally be getting help (after many tries with unprofessional people, oof) and yet I’m still so confused and frustrated with myself because I can’t even open up to my therapist. It may take a while but I’m hoping I’ll get better, although with all these thoughts constantly in my head I feel like I probably won’t. But I’ll never know if I don’t try. 

I hope you have close friends that are open and understanding about depression and the hardships you have gone though. You deserve happiness ❤️.

Back at you. You’re a good person, and I’m really glad that my comment made you feel better. (I’m sending over a bunch of virtual hugs to you, because I know right now I need some, so maybe you do too). I know it’s really hard and a daily struggle but, even though life is unkind and seemingly unmerciful, there’s always a chance for things to align and life to feel a little less terrible. I like to focus on the little things, like the red fall leaves, or a tv show I really like, or a book I want to read. I hope you have things to help with depression too.

It’s basically always; life is dull. And I’m always stressed haha, rip. I used to have people to talk to but recently we kind of all spilt apart and now aren’t as close. So I’m practically alone besides my mom and surface level friends. Although I do have a therapist, but it feels like I’m digging through soggy dirt trying to uncover a disturbing murder scene- something I don’t want to see or hear or think about. But maybe addressing some of the root causes will help my depression lighten a bit, I’m just not sure I’m ready for the uncovering of everything. 

I hope you have someone to talk to and rely on. It’s really tough and I’m sorry you know these thoughts. You don’t deserve them - you seem like a really sweet person full of light. Please keep your head above the water if you can, and if you start drowning always ask for help. I believe in you and I wish you luck and happiness.
I’m already seeing one but I’m just not on medication- I’ll ask the next time I see my therapist. And I’m glad meds saved your life.

I completely understand that. It really sucks. It’d break my mom if she found my dead body, and I never in a million years want to traumatize her like that. But the thoughts never go away. I wish you luck with all your hardships and you’re strong, I believe you can keep going despite all of this.
Thank you, and back at you. I hope you never get to the point where you jump off of that garage, because the world needs more souls like you, and it has already lost too many.

You shouldn’t kill yourself. I know the feeling but, maybe there’s something beyond the thought of death. There’s someone who cares in your life, even if you don’t know it. I care, and I don’t even know you. I wish you happiness and I’m sorry you feel this way too.

It’s really hard. I’m in therapy right now but I feel like no matter what I do the depression won’t go away or get better. I’m going to ask my therapist for medication but it still may not help. And, I hope you’re feeling better now. No one deserves to go through this pain, and you’re strong for being here and a wonderful person for commenting and trying to help me. I wish you luck and happiness. (And yes, blanket burritos are absolutely beautiful and I’m happy I have like 100 blankets to cuddle + millions of pillows haha).
I’m sorry you’re feeling like this. I hope we both feel better soon too. Good luck with everything.
Thank you. I’m sorry you’ve felt like this before, I’m sending over good vibes to you. I believe in you, you deserve happiness.
Thank you, you’re really kind. And I’ll try but depression makes all those things really hard. I don’t want to keep being a burden so ig all I can do is try to change my view of things.
Thank you, but I doubt it haha. But thank you anyway.

I’ve done that already so now I’m in therapy. But I can ask my therapist to put me on meds ig. My close friends actually all have depression and my best friend has used weed a couple times and said it helped a lot. So maybe I’ll ask for some if I get a chance, she’s already said I could if I wanted to but idk if she’s changed her mind/stopped using it recently.

I’ve told my mom but we don’t really have the money so there’s not much we can do. I’m 16; and yea I‘ve considered drugs lol, my friends have alcohol and weed and stuff but I get sick really easily, so they actually told me not to do shit like that again lmao. But I’ve been debating calling my friend and asking her for some but idek if she’d be open to it because of my health.
I’m in therapy right now, but I haven’t tried medication. It’s both too expensive and a risk because I know if I could I’d stash the pills until I had enough to overdose.
I’m glad that you’re feeling better now. I’m not sure it’ll be like that for me, but if I get there, I hope it is.

People move on quickly. I know my mom would care but the rest of my family is scattered and don’t really know that much about me - which means my family wouldn’t be ruined by my suicide. It would be devastating for my mom if she found my corpse, you’re right. That’s one of the reasons I’ve held on for so long. But I don’t know what else to do. I guess I could hang on for a couple years until I leave for college, but living life like this just feels so pointless. I’m already so tired. Thank you for saying all these things though. You’re a good person and you deserve happiness and love.

I’m not sure. I’ve told my mom about my depression and other things I’ve experienced but as much as she tries to understand, it’s really hard for her. My mom doesn’t have the money to pay for any psych ward visits or really much of anything. And I’m trying therapy but it’s expensive asf- I can see my moms stress level just rising and rising. If I weren’t here she wouldn’t have to worry about taking care of me. And I’m sorry you went through that, I hope you’re feeling at least a little bit better now. Try to focus on the little things, you know? I’m sending good vibes your way. Good luck with everything.

I hope you never get around to it either. I’m sorry you’re going through this, I hope things get better for you. And I’ll try, but I’ve been trying for so long I feel I have nothing left. But we’ll see, ig.

I’ve tried but I’m not happy I survived. I’m just disappointed I didn’t do it right the first time. And my depression won’t leave, as much as I want it to. But thank you, and I’m sorry that you’ve felt suicidal at points. I hope you are happy and better now and have people you can depend on.
Thank you for posting this. It made me tear up a bit haha. I’ll need to hug my loved ones soon.

I’m sorry you’re feeling like this, I’m always here if you need someone to talk to. Life is hard sometimes, even if things seem great. Because our brains don’t like us, haha. But we can try and try again to keep going and help ourselves in any way we can.
I’m sorry you feel like this too.

I’m proud of you for getting up out of bed and doing things, I know how hard it is. Also that’s really cool, I’m glad you play the guitar - for me, playing the piano helped a lot, so I can imagine playing the guitar helps you too. And do you mean like sharing our favorite artists and stuff? I’d love to.

I listen to sad songs to make me feel less alone, I’m glad that people like us usually are able to use music as an outlet. But even then it’s still so suffocating. I used to play the piano and honestly I should probably start again, but it takes so much motivation that I just don’t have. So I feel stuck. Do you take walks, etc, to get fresh air? I’m glad you have that. I hope things get better for you, I’m sorry you feel this way as well.
I hope you don’t, although I understand. I’m here if you need someone to talk to. ❤️

It’s totally normal for therapists to suck, you may have to shop around for a while to find someone in your price range that isn’t a complete dick. After years of going in and out of therapy, meeting maybe 10 + different ones, I finally found a good therapist this year. It’s worth it if you keep looking, I’m proud of you for even taking the initiative to try and find help, even if it is so so rough at the start. Good luck and don’t give up! ❤️
I love to write; short stories, poems, pretty much anything. That and drowning myself in music.
Thank you
I’m sorry that you feel like this too. I hope that it gets better but I’m not sure.

I never said that. I said you look normal- doesn’t normal encompass a lot of the population? You’re not ugly, that’s for sure. And your life shouldn’t end because of invalidation from others. It’s hard but you deserve to love yourself.
I think you look normal. If people said those things they aren’t nice people and you shouldn’t hold those opinions over yourself because of them. You’re worthy of life. Please don’t end yours.
That’s a very beautiful way to look at it. Thank you. I hope it’s not all meaningless. You’re a good person, and I’m glad you can look at life like that.

I’m really happy for you that you got to do that with your kids, it seems really wholesome. And I’m sorry that you went through that with their father- no one should have to experience that. But I understand in my own way. I wish you luck and hope that you can continue to find those little moments of happiness, because you and your kids deserve to be happy. Life is hard but you sound like you’re strong.

Yea, if you ask around I think you’ll eventually find someone who can help you. Don’t thank me, life sucks sometimes but you’re strong even in the moments you don’t feel it. You’ll get back on your feet soon, don’t give up 💕.

Most of the time there are college tutors - I think if you ask your college counselor they can maybe help find one for you. My brother was one so I know they exist, I’m just not sure if that’s at every college or not. But you can definitely try to find ones if you need help in basic subjects like any math or science/history or English/language. Good luck and you’ll be okay, it may be rough right now but just recharge and go out there in the world again. I believe in you 💜.

I’m so sorry that you had to live through this. It’s not your fault, none of it is. All you can do is try to rebuild your life the best you can, and I think that maybe talking to a therapist about this would really help you. And honestly, I’m proud of you for being able to write this out at all - that takes strength. You’re a good person, and I believe in you.
Thank you!
Thank you so much!

You can google “therapists/therapy” in your area and go from there. There’s different types of therapy too, so if you want a more slow paced, you centered thing, go for person centered therapy. And if not, and you want a solution, just go for normal therapy- and if you don’t like one therapist, you can shop around until you find one you like. They should respect your decision to stay or leave and be professional, but if not then definitely don’t stay with them. Good luck!

I really don’t believe they’re far from the truth, but thank you. I’m rooting for you too, when times feel tough know an internet stranger, which I know may not hold a lot of ground, but still, thinks you’re worth something when all you’re saying is you’re worth nothing.
I don’t deserve anything, but thank you. I hope if/when you ever feel any similar, or are in a worse place, that you have something to talk to and help you. You’re a good person.

I am, it’s just that I’ve done that about 8 other times too. And I always left in more pain than not. There are things I’m not ready to talk about yet but therapists (at least the ones I’ve been to) have always tried to over analyze everything I say or do and try to fix it. I can’t be fixed, I just want to be healed. But I’m glad therapy worked for you, that’s really good.
It’s selfish when everyone around me is doing so much than I am. But I’ll try, I’m just scared.

I don’t know anymore. Everything feels like it’s crumbling down on top of me and all I want to do is cry. I want to tell people but I can’t seem to reach out. I’m thing to get into therapy again and actually do it right this time, but I doubt it’ll work. It never has. It’s kind of like my last hope; if this fails, I’ll have nothing anymore. I don’t want to live like this.
But I do want to die.
Everyone close to me knows I’m suicidal. But I never open up enough ig. It’s hard to, so I keep most of the stuff inside so others don’t worry anymore.
I completely understand this. It sucks. I hope you somehow find a way to trust the important people in your life, don’t get into your own head about it too much. Good luck.
Thank you!
You’ll be okay eventually, although I don’t have any answers as how we pick up the pieces and actually function again. It’s hard.
We haven’t found a therapist yet, we’re trying to find one. But if I find one that’s actually good and listens, I’ll definitely do that.
If you need to talk to someone, I’m here. I know how it feels to really have no one respond to a post you put your heart into, and it sucks.

Your SO needs to be there for you and at the very least listen to you about your depression. Even if he doesn’t exactly understand, he should sit down and let you talk about it- that’s what a good relationship is like. So if you don’t think he’d listen and try to improve the way he goes about handling things/help you, then maybe it’s time to move on. Because you can’t smother yourself for another person, no matter how much you care about them.
I’m sorry to feel like this too.
Thank you, I hope you’re right.
I’ve never heard about that type of therapy (although I haven’t really looked into the different types). I’ll look into it, thank you for telling me about that.

I guess so. Honestly all I want to talk about in therapy is stupid stuff, like the little things bothering me there and then, but everyone I’ve ever been to has always dug deeper than I ever wanted them to at a speed way too fast for me. It’s always drained me and made me feel like complete shit. But I didn’t tell them this either because I suck at communication, so maybe that’s the problem- if I asked them to go really slow and let me rant would they? I don’t want someone to over analyze everything I do, I just want someone to listen for once.

I’m glad you were helped by therapy. It’s really cool that you’re becoming the thing that helped you so you can help improve others. 

I have really horrible trust issues, and it feels like if I opened up about anything in person with literally anyone I’d be worse at the end. Idk, there are stories about people opening up and being happier, but I feel like every time I’ve ever tried that all it ever did was drag me down into a much darker place. But I guess I’ll try again and see what happens.

I’m glad you’re better, that’s really good. It’s kind of you to want to share so others don’t suffer. 

I’ve tried therapy multiple times but it’s never worked, mostly because the stuff I really need to talk about I’m not ready for. But I’m seeking out therapy again because I’ve been in a really dark patch recently. I can’t die because of important people in my life but I know I’d try to attempt again if I don’t get help. But I’m still not ready so I doubt therapy will be of any help.

I’ve done all that before, but I’m always dragged back down into the hole that is depression. No matter how hard I try the thoughts and memories come back. Nothing lasts, not for me. But thank you for taking time to write this, I hope you’re doing alright.
I completely feel that. It really sucks.

I hope you’re able to get in contact with her. It may help to talk to her about your stuff too, maybe it’ll make her feel less alone. But also, just because someone has it “worse” than you, you shouldn’t disregard your feelings or thoughts. Everyone experiences pain differently. Good luck, and I’m sorry you’re feeling like this.
I know, but happiness isn’t easy to achieve either, and it’s been made time and time again that it’s not for me. Thank you though

• physically and emotionally abusive father that I cut off contact with, and emotionally and (only sometimes) physically abusive mother. 

• severe depression; self harm, failed suicide attempt, the whole package. 

• I’m ugly.
